verdict_reason: The import swap is correct, but the test's only assertion is a zero-count poll that passes on its first try and cannot fail.

todos.issue: The only assertion, expect.poll(countDocuments({ aggregateId, eventType: NOTIFICATION_WITHDRAWN })).toBe(0) (29-33), passes on its first poll, before the backend has had any time to write an event, so the test cannot fail even if deleting a draft did write NotificationWithdrawn. It is also an absence check where a positive one is possible.
todos.fix: Must: the test goes red if deleting a draft writes a NotificationWithdrawn event. One way: first poll until the draft's NotificationDeleted event exists, then assert the exact list of event types for the aggregate (e.g. ['NotificationCreated', 'NotificationDeleted']).
